aboutText: Braetex Electrical has been serving Brunswick East and surrounding areas with over 40 years of combined experience in the electrical industry. Our team of licensed electricians specialise in commercial projects, EV installations, and solar systems, ensuring all work meets Australian safety standards. We pride ourselves on being upfront about timelines, processes, and costs to deliver projects efficiently and with exceptional customer service.
servicesText: We offer a wide range of electrical services tailored to both residential and commercial clients in Brunswick East. Our expertise includes EV installations, solar and battery systems, smart metering, and ongoing maintenance, all delivered with a commitment to safety and excellence.
